name: Advanced Filesystem: Document Processor
description: DOCX processing submodule of Advanced FileSystem: pure-PHP text/metadata extraction (ZipArchive), LibreOffice PDF/HTML/ODT conversion, metadata stripping, template filling, bulk find-replace, track-change acceptance, version diff, PDF sign/merge/page-range and page thumbnails, with PII detection and a per-file dashboard.

suggests.libreoffice (soffice): external binary — required for DOCX to PDF/HTML/ODT conversion.
suggests.ghostscript (gs): external binary — required for PDF sign, merge, page-range, keep/remove pages and page thumbnails.
suggests.ext-zip: ZipArchive — required for all pure-PHP DOCX read/write operations.
suggests.ext-simplexml: used by the DOCX text parser.

project_description: Advanced Filesystem: Document Processor adds a DOCX-centric processing pipeline to the Advanced FileSystem framework. It extracts plain text and core/app properties from Word documents entirely in PHP via ZipArchive (no external dependency for reading), and layers optional external-tool operations on top: LibreOffice (soffice) converts documents to PDF, HTML or ODT; Ghostscript (gs) signs, merges, splits, page-ranges and thumbnails the resulting PDFs. Additional pure-PHP tools fill {{VARIABLE}} templates, bulk find-and-replace, strip hidden metadata, accept tracked changes, generate a table of contents, extract embedded images, validate hyperlinks and produce an HTML word-level diff between two versions. Each file gets a job row (adfs_document_jobs) plus derivative and page-thumbnail tables, a per-file Document Info view, a batch processor and an admin dashboard. A regex-based PII detector flags CPF/CNPJ/e-mail/card patterns. All routes and file downloads are gated behind the restricted 'administer advanced_filesystem_document_processor' permission.
